name: Tri-HE
description: Tri-HE is a benchmark designed to evaluate hallucinations in large vision-language models at the triplet level, measuring both object hallucination and relation hallucination simultaneously. It focuses on hallucinations in (object, relation, object) triplets extracted from model responses, enabling comprehensive evaluation across vision-language tasks.
reputation: A niche but relevant hallucination benchmark for vision-language models, with limited adoption outside recent hallucination-evaluation work.
notes: Addresses both object and relation hallucination; includes a training-free mitigation approach achieving performance comparable to GPT-4V.
